features.note: ln(1 + silence_hours / own_median_cadence_hours) / ln(31). Reaches 1.0 when a vessel has been silent 30x its own observed reporting interval; clipped at 1.5 (ratio ~170x) so extreme gaps keep separating instead of saturating. THE ranking signal — deviation from the vessel's own baseline, the same invariant FIRMS uses.
Binary: last reported speed > 5 kn. A vessel that stops transmitting mid-passage is a stronger signal than one that goes quiet at anchor.
Binary: current flag in the FOC list. Elevates risk only in combination with anomalous silence.

notes: v3: silence is scored against each vessel's OWN cadence (vessel_cadence, mig 111) instead of an absolute log-hours term. v2's single monotone gap feature made the top of the leaderboard a 22-way tie at the window-bounded maximum; ranking reduced to 'oldest fix wearing a convenient flag'. Weights validated against production 2026-08-24: 519 scoreable vessels -> 204 leads >=0.3, 98 alerts >=0.6, top-25 nearly all distinct at 3dp, top lead a vessel silent 54x its own cadence having vanished at 13.5 kn. Vessels WITHOUT a cadence baseline are not scored (composite NULL, 'observed, not yet scorable') - never defaulted. GATED upstream by the mig-110 dead-box VOID gate. The v1 cargo/port-call/owner placeholders remain removed; restore only with a real data source.
